title: Thousand Promotions
reviewNotes: Three branches check the final seven-piece rook and queen diagrams: Rd8 before d1 promotion at 163s, after d1=Q+ at 164s, and Qd8/d1=Q+ at 145s. Rxd1 leaves king flights and wins; Qxd1 is actual stalemate. An independent Black knight promotion is captured with the same winning result. The earlier ten/eight-piece sequence and initial rook-underpromotion decision remain source context, not an exact proof of that larger setup.
